title: Fppf sheafification presentation of a homogeneous right-coset quotient
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $G,H$ be $F$-group schemes with homomorphism $i:H\to G$ [def-sc-group-scheme], and let $Q$ be an $F$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-over-base] with morphism $\pi:G\to Q$. On the big fppf site over $\operatorname{Spec}F$ [def-pc-fppf-site], call $(Q,\pi)$ a right-coset presentation if: $h_\pi$ is locally surjective; $h_Q$ is a sheaf; there is an isomorphism $G\times_F H\simeq G\times_QG$ with projections $(g,h)\mapsto g$ and $(g,h)\mapsto g i(h)$; and, for the presheaf coequalizer $C$ of these projection and multiplication maps, there is $\eta:C\to h_Q$ with $h_G\to C\to h_Q=h_\pi$ such that composition with $\eta$ gives a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(h_Q,Z)\to\operatorname{Hom}(C,Z)$ for every fppf sheaf of sets $Z$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Products and fibre products are those of schemes [def-pc-fibre-product]. Test schemes and values use the common universe of $G,H,Q$. The quotient $Q$ need not carry a group structure, and $H$ need not be normal, smooth, connected or reduced.
